security.csp: default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; img-src 'self' asset: http://asset.localhost data: blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:; worker-src 'self' blob:; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'

bundle.longDescription: Connect, inspect metadata, and run bounded read-only queries against PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, and MongoDB with optional Redrob AI assistance. Identity-verifying TLS uses publicly trusted certificate authorities; custom and self-signed certificate authorities are not supported in this release.
